title: On Universal Virtual and Welded Braid Groups and Their Linear Representations
summary: We introduce linear representations of the universal virtual braid group $UV_n(c)$, where $n\geq 2$ and $c\geq 1$, which is a unifying framework for braid-type groups with multiple types of crossings. We classify and study its complex homogeneous $2$-local representations for all $n\geq 3$ and $c\geq 1$ (unique up to equivalence) and complex homogeneous $3$-local representations for all $n\geq 4$ and $c=2$ (four distinct families). We then introduce the universal welded braid group $UW_n(c)$ as a quotient of $UV_n(c)$ by the welded relations. This group recovers all known welded-type groups…
